{{Quote|I know Dreypa, for one, has had his eye on a Sith priestess.|Sorzus Syn|<ref name="BOS" />}}
An '''unidentified Sith priestess''' aroused the interest of [[Remulus Dreypa]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and [[Dark Jedi/Legends|fallen]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], around [[6900 BBY]]. Along with his fellow [[exiles]], Dreypa had discovered the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], inhabited by the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The aforementioned Sith woman, a member of the priestly [[Kissai]] caste, became an object of lust for Dreypa, who feared to see his [[Blood/Legends|bloodline]] die with him. While the Sith and the Humans were normally incompatible, it was discovered that [[Sith alchemy/Legends|alchemical]] [[Hybrid/Legends|crossbreeding]] could still be achieved.<ref name="BOS" />
